svg.text: Same affine rules, same random seed, different iteration budgets.
The point is not just that the fern exists. It is that density and leaflet structure emerge in layers as the orbit keeps landing on the same attractor.
just enough points to reveal the stem and first leaflet hints
the midrib stabilizes and the fern stops looking accidental
secondary leaflets start reading as structure instead of noise
density arrives and the silhouette becomes hard to miss
the upper canopy and side detail keep tightening
same rules, same seed, just a larger iteration budget
